We have applied template 1914393 to target molecule, got a tuple of precursors: ('COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'). That seems two fragments: first is aromatic with methoxy and amide to a triazine? Actually it's a phenyl with amide to a di-aza? Anyway.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each appropriate fragment? The order must be 1914393, then 1914394, then 1914395. Likely each step splits one fragment further.

We need to apply 1914394 to one of the precursors that matches its pattern. Template 1914394 seems to involve a chlorine attached to CH2Cl group and an aromatic ring with a substituent. The retro_smarts: [#7:3]-[C:4]-[c:5]1... with a side chain -[CH2;D2;+0:1]-[Cl] etc. So it likely breaks a C-Cl bond attached to aromatic via CH2Cl.

Our second precursor is 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1' which contains a CCl substituent on phenyl. That matches. So apply template 1914394 to that molecule.
